# The RT64 shaders the web page builds: one shader description a line, other mode L and H, color combiner L and H,
# flags, in hex. RT64 specializes each one's WGSL when the page is built and builds them with the game waiting: those
# above the first "section" line before the game starts, and a section when a frame first wants 4 of its shaders,
# so that nothing draws with the ubershader, which integrated graphics can't afford (N64Recomp-browser's README,
# "Give RT64 a list of the game's shaders").
#
# Recorded by code, not by playing: bash tools/record_shaders.sh (its header says how) runs N64Recomp-browser's
# tools/record_shaders.mjs with tools/shader_plan.json, which loads the page fresh for each section and has
# tools/shader_survey.js start each race the way the pause menu's Retry does, with the kart AI driving. Section 0 is
# the launcher, the logos and the title; then the menus to a Grand Prix's first race, each course at 150cc for a lap
# or more, each battle arena with four players, Versus with two and three, Time Trials, a race's finish and results,
# the award ceremony and the credits. Not recorded: the menus past those a Grand Prix passes through (options, data,
# records), mirror mode, ghosts, and what a course draws further in than the AI drove. Flags follow settings
# (filtering, HDR, MSAA, upscaling), so a change to one of those defaults means recording again.
